info.title: API-DocTest-List Investment Portfolio Statements-v5-spec
info.description: The Investment Portfolio Statements Retrieval API allows users to access comprehensive statements related to their investment portfolios. This endpoint is designed for financial advisors and individual investors seeking to review detailed reports of their investment performance. Typical use cases include generating statements for analysis, tracking gains and losses, and monitoring asset allocation over time. By leveraging this API, users can gain insights into their portfolio's health and make informed investment decisions.
